name: sholynk-technology
description: Sholynk Tech — a technology publication: AI, Web3, cryptocurrency and software stories, with an editorial CMS.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sholynk/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sholynk/api && npm run typecheck:js
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply sholynk_tech --local --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply sholynk_tech --remote --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrations:list: wrangler d1 migrations list sholynk_tech --local --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.verify: npm run check:config && npm run check:lock && npm run check:structure && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.deploy:api: npm run check:config -- --strict && npm run deploy:production -w @sholynk/api
